answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must register identities along an interconnected trust trellis, locking and burning cryptographic stake. Instead of linear fees that leave defense hollow, registration requires burning stake scaled superlinearly as $C(n) = k \cdot n^{1.5}$ for $n$ coordinated nodes. Each validator node deposits a crystal collateral receipt, forcing an exponential economic cost on attackers attempting mass identity forgery.
